SubagentStop.trigger: the end of an Agent tool run

PermissionRequest.trigger: a Write or Bash call that needs the owner (dialog)

TaskCompleted.trigger: a TaskUpdate tool call with status completed

CwdChanged.tried: NOT FIRED. Tried: Bash calls "cd .claude && pwd" and "cd .. && pwd" (the Bash tool resets its cwd after each call)
